title: People split: Public users and Staff users
summary: Administrators now see two separate lists under People: Public users for public accounts only, and Staff users for staff, volunteers, students and admins.
changes: Public users now lists only public accounts. Staff-side and Cloudron accounts are no longer mixed in.
The People item that was called Staff is now called Staff users, in the menu, page title, breadcrumb and search.
Staff users has a role filter for staff, volunteers, students and admins, and shows an Admin badge.
Cloudron accounts that no Cloudron group maps to a role are listed under Staff users with a No Cloudron group mapped badge that links to Access.
The admin overview shows how many public users and staff users there are.
A new admin command reports accounts in the wrong list and, after confirmation, refreshes Cloudron accounts from their groups.
Agents and contributors now pull the latest main before starting any work.
version_rationale: Minor: adds the Staff users role filter, badges, overview counts and an admin command, with no database changes.
validation: New feature tests for the account classifier, both People lists, the rename, the badges and the admin command.
Browser check of Public users, Staff users and the admin overview.
known_limitations: The admin command only refreshes Cloudron accounts. Local accounts that appear in a Cloudron group are listed for review and are not changed.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. There are no migrations, and nothing stored depends on this release.
provenance: Milestone v0.52.0 Beta: People, epic #491 with issues #492 to #498, plus #648 and #650, shipped in pull request #652.
